title: Interval power telemetry intake protocol
purpose: Define a lossless, source-aware contract for interval electricity telemetry without converting queue or service capacity into synthetic meter data.
source_hierarchy: Public site-level interval meter or regulator data
System/BA-level load data as context only
rules: System-level data cannot be promoted to site-level telemetry.
Queue/interconnection MW and contracted capacity are not meter observations.
Annual estimates are not converted into synthetic intervals.
Every interval retains source, meter boundary, timezone and quality flags.
Missing intervals are explicit gaps unless separately labeled as estimates.
Negative, duplicate, overlapping or impossible intervals are rejected or quarantined.
acceptance_test: A site-level telemetry record is admissible only when facility identity, meter boundary, interval definition, source provenance and quality semantics are retained.
